notes.title: Version 0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone :)

Cozy Escapes is now playable as a co-op. Some bugs have been fixed, and the next updates are already in the works. If you have any requests, suggestions, or found bugs, feel free to join the Discord channel and share your thoughts in the dedicated channels.

I wish you lots of fun playing!

notes.title: Version 0.1.2
notes.notes: Small bug fixes and added a menu to reset objects.
